items.title: Kyle Lowry playing for the Raptors changed the trajectory of my life.
items.author: Keerthika Uthayakumar
items.body_excerpt:
Kyle Lowry playing for the Raptors changed the trajectory of my life.

He made me fall in love with basketball in 2013 & then I spent years yelling about his impact, trying to contextualize his value beyond the boxscore.

Now I use stats to tell basketball stories for a living. Wild.
